department: KIT Department of Chemical and Process Engineering

deadline.value: No closing date is stated; the candidate must apply within six months of starting work at an institute.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A written doctoral agreement between the candidate and the supervisor must be attached to the application.
supervisor.quote: between doctoral candidate and supervisor (obligatory since 01-01-2015)

funding.value: The department page does not say how doctoral researchers are funded.

entry_route.value: Doctoral candidates normally need a German master's-level degree or an equivalent foreign degree; highly qualified bachelor's holders can be admitted under special rules.
entry_route.quote: Graduation at a German university (diploma, Magister, master, or state examination) or an equivalent degree achieved at a university abroad

also.quote: A certified copy of the degree certificate with a transcript of grades (the overall grade must be 2.5 or better)

notes: Initial acceptance is for three years, extendable by one year. Foreign degrees need a certificate of equivalence from the International Students Office.
